about.heading: About me
about.statement: I studied AI and data science, then took it into marketing.
paragraphs: I started as a digital marketing intern in April 2026 and became Digital Marketing Manager that July. My day is split between performance marketing on Meta and Google, and building automations that save the team from repeating the same task twice.
I care most about lead generation, video marketing and putting AI to practical use: prompts that produce usable content, and workflows that run without someone watching them.

projects.title: Adventure Works Power BI Dashboard
projects.imageCaption: Executive dashboard: revenue, profit, orders, return rate and monthly trends
projects.overview: An interactive Power BI report on the Adventure Works bike-shop dataset that tracks revenue, profit, orders and returns, with drill-through pages for products, customers and regions.
objectives: Track the headline KPIs: revenue, profit, orders and return rate.
Show how sales move month by month against a trend line.
Find the top products and the product types returned most.
Let users drill from the summary into product, customer and map views.
contributions: Built dynamic dashboards for sales, revenue, profit, returns, customer behaviour and product trends.
Wrote DAX measures for the KPI cards, month-over-month comparisons and return rates.
Created drill-through reports for product and customer detail.
Added what-if parameters, custom tooltips, anomaly highlights and visual-level filters.
Designed the pages for clear, readable data storytelling.
process: Loaded and related the Adventure Works sales, returns, product, customer and territory tables.
Wrote DAX for the KPIs and month-over-month comparisons.
Laid out the executive summary, then the product, customer and map pages.
Added drill-through, tooltips and parameters so the report can be explored.
projects.metricsNote: Totals from the Adventure Works sample dataset shown in the report.

video.caption: Screen recording of the report in use (sound removed).

projects.title: Sales Performance Dashboard 2025
projects.imageCaption: Dashboard sheet: KPI cards, revenue by month, region and product, with slicers
projects.overview: An interactive Excel dashboard built on 199 sales orders from January to March 2025, using pivot tables, KPI formulas and slicers to show revenue by month, region, product and salesperson.
objectives: Show total revenue, order count and average order value at a glance.
Compare performance across regions, products and salespeople.
Let the reader filter everything by month and region.
contributions: Structured the raw order data into an Excel table.
Built pivot tables for revenue by region, month, product and salesperson.
Built KPI cards with GETPIVOTDATA so they update with the slicers.
Created pivot charts and connected month and region slicers.
Laid out a one-page dashboard for business reporting.
process: Cleaned and structured the order data: date, region, salesperson, product, quantity, unit price, revenue.
Linked the KPI cells to the pivots with GETPIVOTDATA.
Designed the dashboard sheet with charts and slicers.
deliverables: KPI cards for revenue, orders and average order value
Revenue charts by month, region and product
projects.metricsNote: Figures from the project dataset, January to March 2025.

projects.title: Smart Attendance Management System
projects.imageCaption: The desktop app with the face registration form open
projects.overview: A desktop attendance system that registers students by face and is designed to mark attendance with face recognition and email the attendance report.
objectives: Replace manual roll calls with face recognition.
Register each student once with name, roll number and face.
Keep an attendance list staff can open from the app.
contributions: Built the Tkinter desktop interface for the department.
Wrote face registration with OpenCV and the face_recognition library, storing face encodings in a JSON database.
Wrote the attendance list viewer that reads the attendance CSV.
Wrote the email module that sends the report as an attachment over SMTP.
